snippet.title: Bel's Fanfare New Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
New gameplay reveal from Bel's Fanfare — an RPG with rich deep exploration and expressive combat inspired by classic Zelda games, Undertale and Spirited Away. 

You play as Bel, the new aura cleaner of the once-luxurious vessel The Witch of the Sea.

Add it to your wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4317460/Bels_Fanfare/


#indiegame #gamedev #rpg #zelda #exploration #bullethell #retro
